source: Organizer Technical info supplied by participant, getting-started PDF, and official starter README/main.py

sandbox.memory: 2 GB as published; exact byte accounting not specified

market.identity: anonymised; do not infer currency or asset from price
market.time_unit: seconds on tape; microseconds in callbacks
market.matching: price-time priority; fill at resting order price
market.activation: before first market event at or after call time plus latency
market.markout: liquidation against opposite resting market orders, not midpoint

submissions.public_data: same public tape as local; sandbox/run compatibility check

scoring.normalization: round PnL standardized against positive-PnL teams
scoring.nonpositive: excluded from mean/std pool and scored as effective PnL zero

git.access_status: pending Write invitation already exists; Read-only personal-repo role unavailable

deadline_note: Verify actual dashboard submission-close time each round; do not infer it from schedule alone.
